Notes from the bluff.

Occasional writing about the coast, the kitchen and the seasons — mostly by people who work here and have strong opinions about the weather.

  • Seasons · January 18, 2026

    The case for winter on this coast

    Everyone comes in August. The coast is arguably better in February, and it is certainly more itself.

  • Kitchen · November 4, 2025

    Where the oysters come from

    Forty minutes north, in a bay that freezes the hands of everyone who works it. A morning with the people who grow what we open at seven.

  • Coast · September 22, 2025

    A field guide to the bluff trail

    Four miles, one gate, and about six things worth stopping for. What to look at between the front door and the point.

Read the winter one, then book February.
